properties.title: Gridded Population of the World, Version 4 (GPWv4): National Identifier Grid
properties.description: The Gridded Population of the World, Version 4 (GPWv4): National Identifier Grid is derived from the input census units to create a raster surface where pixels (grid cells) that cover the same census data source - most often a country or territory - have the same value. Note that these data represent the area covered by the statistical data as provided, and are not official representations of country or territory boundaries.
properties.sci:citation: Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016-07-11. Gridded Population of the World, Version 4 (GPWv4): National Identifier Grid. Version 4.0. ESDIS. Palisades, NY. https://doi.org/10.7927/H41V5BX1
ciesin:authors: Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University
ciesin:publishers: NASA Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC)
properties.ciesin:purpose: To provide a raster representation of nation-states in GPWv4 for use in aggregating population data.
